title: VIXEN FidelityFX custom commands hash the ambient PATH
body: FidelityFXFsr3.cmake embedded the caller's ambient PATH in every FidelityFX_SC.exe custom-command environment. The live box queue supplies a different temporary PATH per invocation, so Ninja marked all 40 shader-blob edges dirty even when the SDK inputs and output cache were unchanged. Recovery changed the command environment to the SDK-only tool directory, which contains FidelityFX_SC.exe and glslangValidator.exe. Make the shader command hash depend only on its declared tool directory or provide a stable queue environment.
